darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 139: scopes full analysis to the selected library and improves Sample Grid handling of all libraries and offline files. Adds wheel control over VOL and V ZOOM sliders, clearer TAKTUS ON, Loop Tool stretch past a sample end, and 24-bit PCM as the default WAV export. SHUF traverses filtered results without repeats and automatically plays another random sample after natural full-playback completion, even with AUTOPLAY off; Stop, loops, selections and short navigation previews do not advance.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 397: Portable Library Index REVIEW waits for active saves, detects changed sidecars and offers retry for read errors. Sync verifies state safely under SQLite locks; sidebar and context menu clarify pending, verifying and failed states. A Welcome Certificate appears after first successful license activation and can be reopened from Help by licensed users. Instructions now cover these workflows.
